metadata.title: Vintage Soft-Focus Portrait with High-Contrast Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A centered, soft-focus portrait of a woman against a deep black void, featuring a single vibrant red floral accent and a three-tier typographic header combining thin geometric sans and formal script.
triggerTerms: thin geometric sans and script pairing
soft focus portrait on black background

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered medium-shot portrait of a blonde woman with a 1960s bouffant hairstyle, wearing a pale cream blouse and holding a large red poppy. The subject is isolated against a solid black background, with the top third of the frame dedicated to centered, high-contrast white text in a mix of thin sans-serif and elegant script.
coreVisualRelationships: The vibrant red poppy acts as a singular color anchor against the neutral palette.
The soft, diffused lighting on the subject contrasts with the sharp, clean lines of the typography.
The vertical stack of text in the upper third balances the visual weight of the subject in the lower two-thirds.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered medium shot, occupying the bottom 70% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The red poppy held in the lower right quadrant of the subject.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the top text, moves down the subject's face, and rests on the red poppy.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive black negative space surrounding the subject and text, creating a sense of isolation.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with one high-saturation red point; high value contrast between subject and background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and formal copperplate-style script
letterConstructionRules: Sans-serif: Extremely thin strokes, high waistlines, circular 'O's.
Script: Slanted, fluid connections, high contrast between thick and thin strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'Y' in the sans-serif has a deep, centered junction.
The script features elongated swashes on the initial and terminal letters.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between a rigid, thin geometric sans and a fluid, high-contrast script.
graphicDevices: Quotation marks around the script subtitle
Colon separator in the third line

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and thin strokes of the primary title.
Provides the necessary formal script contrast with elegant swashes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A soft-focus, grainy film-style portrait of a blonde woman with 1960s hair, wearing a cream blouse, holding a single large red poppy, centered against a solid black background. Leave the top 30% of the image as empty black space.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add three lines of centered white text in the top black area. Line 1: Thin geometric sans-serif in all caps. Line 2: Formal script in title case with quotation marks. Line 3: Smaller thin geometric sans-serif in all caps.

verificationChecks: Is the red poppy the only vibrant color?
Is the top text perfectly centered?
Does the typography use a mix of hairline sans and script?

mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or brand logos
The exact facial features of the woman
Specific catalog numbers in the corner

mustAchieve: Soft, diffused lighting on the subject

postGenerationChecks: Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's head.
Check that the red of the flower is saturated but not glowing.
Verify the 'vintage' film texture is subtle and uniform.
Confirm the script font is legible despite its decorative nature.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centered Subject + Black Void + Hairline Geometric Sans + Formal Script + Single Color Accent
